data.title: Project Zomboid
data.description: Survive the apocalypse on the Project Zomboid server at MBG Playground. Build, scavenge, and cooperate with other survivors in a persistent world.
data.features:
• Modded gameplay experience.
  • Infinite electricity and water supply with occasional outages.
  • Items left on the floor for over 256 in-game hours will be deleted. (Placed items are not affected)
  • No wipes, unless necessary.
Last Wipe: August 2, 2026
